text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A CSTR is uniform at its outlet state; its volume is an outlet-rate rectangle

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Same k=0.20 min⁻¹,C_A0=2 mol/L,q=1 L/min as811. Outlet rate is kC_A=0.08 mol/(L·min), so reciprocal rate is12.5 L·min/mol and rectangle area is10
L·min/mol. For this decreasing-rate reaction, CSTR needs more volume than PFR at equal conversion; not universal for every rate curve.
